name: scoped-search-field
title: Scoped search field
description: A search box with a scope menu attached, for searching in Docs, People or Files, that reports the query and the scope together.
docs: scopes is a list of { value, label, placeholder, icon }: the first is chosen at the start, and scope with onScopeChange (or defaultScope) controls it. The empty field shows the placeholder of the chosen scope (Search people by name or email), so it always says what it will search. query, defaultQuery and onQueryChange work the same way for the text. Changing the scope keeps the text and announces Searching in People in a polite live region; choosing it from the open menu also moves the focus on to the field, ready to type. onSearch(query, scope) is called with the trimmed text when Enter is pressed, not for an empty field unless allowEmpty is set; inside a form the form still submits, and name and scopeName put the text and the scope in the submitted data. The first Escape clears the text and the second leaves the field. The field answers to its own width, not the screen's: below 20rem (a container query) the menu shrinks to the scope's icon (the first letter of its label in a small chip when a scope has none) and the shortcut hint goes, while the scope stays in the menu's accessible name (Search in People; scopeLabel changes the first words). The shortcut is a hint only: bind the key yourself. Other input props such as autoFocus and aria-label go to the input, whose accessible name is its placeholder unless you give one.
